name: self_repo_guard_git_target_and_subcommand
notes: Agreed sub-contract restricts inputs to paths that exist on disk: LIVE Path.resolve() normalizes nonexistent paths while C realpath() fails open and returns the unresolved join. Alias keys are lowercase in all inputs (both sides lowercase; inputs avoid the case path). Input grammar: cwd|envspec|argspec, '-' = empty, '+' joins args, ';' joins env pairs.
